messages:
olivia.new: Hey team, first week here — trying to get Vault + KMS access for my service (staging -> prod later). What's the onboarding flow and who approves prod keys?

sam.devex: Welcome Olivia! :wave: Short flow: open a secret_request in #platform-requests with the template, include envs + approver. Infra provisions staging; prod needs a business approver + security approver.

june.security: Adding: list a PM or eng lead as the business approver and @june.security (or delegate) for security. No wildcard paths; use per-env Vault paths. Rotation defaults: static secrets 90d, dynamic DB creds TTL-managed (usually 1h-24h).

olivia.new: Can you paste the request template I should drop in the ticket? Also timeline for staging vs prod?

sam.devex: Template to paste in ticket body (replace placeholders):

secret_request:
  requester: olivia.new
  service: feature-evaluator
  envs: [staging, prod]
  vault_paths:
    - secret/data/feature-evaluator/staging: read
    - secret/data/feature-evaluator/prod: read
  kms_key: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/feature/cryptoKeys/feature-cmk
  use_dynamic_db: true
  approver: @june.security
  reason: CI + runtime DB creds for evaluation jobs

sam.devex: Timeline: staging ~1 business day, prod ~2-3 after approvals. Tag the PM + @june.security in the ticket to speed approvals.

june.security: A couple of notes: 1) Prefer dynamic DB creds via Vault DB engine. 2) For GH Actions use OIDC to mint short-lived Vault tokens (avoid storing static creds in GH). 3) If you need transit (crypto-only) vs KV (storage): use transit for encrypt/decrypt without storing plaintext.

infra-bot: Ticket #PR-9981 created (secret_request). Assigned to infra-ops. ETA staging: 1 business day; prod: 3 business days.

vault-bot: policy "svc-feature-evaluator-staging" created and mounted at secret/data/feature-evaluator/staging (audit id: a8b6).

olivia.new: Thanks! If I hit "permission denied" after policy attach who should I ping?

sam.devex: Ping me or @infra-ops with the exact client error and the service principal. We'll check policy bindings and identity mapping.

june.security: Emergency rotation: open an incident and tag @security. We have a runbook (internal link) — steps: revoke leases, rotate DB creds via Vault, rotate CMK if compromised (coord with infra). Happy to do a quick 15-min walkthrough.

olivia.new: Awesome, opening the ticket now and will ping if anything breaks. Appreciate the help!
